content: Sterol O-acyltransferase 1 (SOAT1), also referred to as acyl-Coenzyme A: cholesterol acyltransferase 1, is an enzyme in humans that is encoded by the SOAT1 gene. This enzyme is an intracellular protein that resides in the endoplasmic reticulum. Its primary function is to catalyze the formation of cholesterol esters from free cholesterol.
